{{Short description|Slovenian physicist and politician}}
[[File:Franci Demsar.jpg|thumb|Franci Demšar]]
'''Franci Demšar''' (born 4&nbsp;February&nbsp;1960) is a [[Slovenia]]n physicist and politician.

From 1997 to 1999, he was Secretary of State at the [[Ministry of Science and Technology (Slovenia)|Ministry of Science and Technology]].<ref name=STA>{{cite news |url=http://znanost.sta.si/2496456/na-celu-nakvisa-franci-demsar |title=Na čelu Nakvisa Franci Demšar |language=sl |trans-title=NAKVIS to be Headed by Franci Demšar |date=23 March 2018 |publisher=Slovenian Press Agency}}</ref> From 4&nbsp;February&nbsp;1999 to 7&nbsp;June&nbsp;2000, he served as the [[Ministry of Defence (Slovenia)|Minister of Defence of the Republic of Slovenia]]. From 2001 to 2004, he was the Slovenian ambassador in the [[Russian Federation]].<ref name=STA />

From 1&nbsp;October&nbsp;2004 to 30&nbsp;October&nbsp;2014, he was the Director of the [[Slovenian Research Agency]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.arrs.si/en/agencija/mandati.asp |title=ARRS Terms of Office |date=3 November 2020}}</ref> Since March 2018, he has been the Director of the [[Slovenian Quality Assurance Agency for Higher Education]] (NAKVIS).<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.nakvis.si/about-sqaa/director-of-the-agency/?lang=en |title=Director of the Agency |publisher=NAKVIS |access-date=1 September 2023}}</ref> In 2020, he was elected President of the [[Central and Eastern European Network of Quality Assurance Agencies in Higher Education]] (CEENQA), and reelected in September 2022.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.ceenqa.org/general-assembly-and-workshop-2022/ |title=General Assembly and Workshop 2022 |date=24 September 2022 |publisher=CEENQA}}</ref>
